# `vox-sql`

**Crate:** `vox-sql` · **Version:** `0.6.0` · **Target:** Library (`lib.rs`)

Engine-agnostic SQL app-plane backends (libSQL, Postgres, MySQL) for Vox.

## Crate Overview

Engine-agnostic SQL surface for Vox app-plane data backends.

Connects via `VOX_APP_DB_URL`, normalizes rows/values, and exposes DDL,
introspection, and migration helpers for brownfield database interop.


## Features

| Feature | Default / Enables |
|---|---|
| `default` | runtime |
| `mysql` | sqlx?/mysql |
| `postgres` | sqlx?/postgres |
| `runtime` | dep:vox-db, dep:turso, dep:sqlx, dep:async-trait, dep:tokio, dep:vox-secrets |
